entry.title: Board of Assessors: the meeting of 6 November 2027 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Assessors will recommend a single (not split) tax rate and rejecting all three optional exemptions for FY2026. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=anpNaB1l9ho), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: Board of Assessors: the meeting of 9 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Board withholds releasing a tax lien on a Chapter Land property until the owner pays years of back taxes owed. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qimi3yNAudg), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
